changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Experiment Run Coordinator to Growth Outcome Analyst route with frozen policy, launch receipts, inconclusive readouts and executable checks.
Accepts findings from SEO and AI Visibility Intelligence in addition to funnel and lifecycle sources.

title: Growth Experimentation and Follow-Through
description: Track one owner-approved growth experiment from exact provider launch evidence to a guarded, reproducible outcome readout; leave underpowered results inconclusive.
setup_prompt: Treat Growth Experimentation and Follow-Through as a proposal. Inspect my frozen experiment plan, owner decision, provider and analytics sources, run owner, guardrail, readout window and existing Crews. Propose reuse or creation of Experiment Run Coordinator and Growth Outcome Analyst, exact evidence validators and one bounded manual case in Builder chat. Selection creates no Crew, task, launch, message or schedule.

setup_inputs.label: Frozen plan artifact, revision, metric, sample and stop policy
Exact owner approval record and change authority
Experiment, provider object, variants, eligible population and assignment
Provider launch/exposure and authorized primary/guardrail data
Identity, contamination, minimum sample and source-lag rules
Rollout, rollback, measurement and review owners
Manual-only or separately reviewed repeat/check policy

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create approved missing run or outcome Crew with stable idempotency key and Workflow step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated exact execution record to the outcome Crew

recommended_tools.name: Experiment or feature-flag MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact variant, assignment, exposure and launch provider receipts

recommended_tools.name: Product analytics or warehouse MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized frozen primary and guardrail outcomes with identity and timestamps

recommended_tools.name: Linear or Jira MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Link approved work and rollback owner without treating a ticket as a launch receipt

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether experiments compound into growth outcomes
Learning rate, prioritization quality, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Reviewed Run Coordinator and Outcome Analyst Crew roster with access and owner map
Validated pending or launched experiment execution record
Validated pending-window, measured or inconclusive readout when launched
Manual first run and paused repeat choice
